units.source_text: ——金花坐在一把精美的紫檀木椅子上，品尝着面前桌子琳琅满目的山珍海味。

en.t: Jinhua sat in an exquisite red sandalwood chair, savoring the dazzling array of rare delicacies from land and sea spread out on the table before her.

units.source_text: 燕窝、鱼翅、蒸蛋、熏鲤、烤乳猪、海参羹——不胜其数。

en.t: Bird's nest, shark fin, steamed egg, smoked carp, roast suckling pig, sea cucumber soup: there were too many dishes to count.

units.source_text: 并且，餐盘也都精美绝伦，绘满青莲和金凤。

en.t: Moreover, the plates were all extraordinarily beautiful, covered with blue lotuses and golden phoenixes.
